free_tier_limits: 15-day trial with Standard-plan features; afterward, a restricted Free plan cannot post jobs or interact with candidates and can only view existing candidate data.
rate_limits: 10 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.
description: Workable is an ATS with a REST API for retrieving jobs and account data and managing candidates, employees, requisitions, and hiring workflows. Current job endpoints retrieve postings; the official API scopes do not document creating or updating job postings.
